Strategy 5 — ROC + EMA + MACD + Stoch RSI, Settings Sweep on Nifty 50 (30 Oct 2026)

On this page

All 50 Nifty 50 stocks, 15-min / 30-min / 1-hour / 4-hour / daily, delivery buys (same-day sells allowed), FYERS charges only, ₹1,00,000 per trade, 1 Jan 2023 – 26 Oct 2026 (15/30-min from 1 Dec 2025). Education, not investment advice. Full report: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STRATEGY5_REPORT.md (every setting tried, train/test, finalists, FYERS charges by type). Every finalist trade: reports/strategy5/final_trades.csv.

1. The rules

Buy when all four are true (all on the traded timeframe):

  1. Rate of Change of the close over 100 candles above 2%
  2. Close above the 100 EMA (that candle only, no 5-candle rule)
  3. MACD histogram bigger than the previous bar
  4. Stoch RSI blue crosses above orange, with blue below 50

Two ways to buy:

  • At the candle close (all four true on the closed candle)
  • During the candle: the moment all four become true. The order of moves inside a candle can't be known from candle data, so it's reported as a range: cautious (if the low reached the sell level, assume it sold in the buy candle) to favourable (sell in the buy candle only when certain).

Sell as soon as blue touches orange during any later candle, at that exact price (the open if it gaps there).

Settings tried (one indicator at a time, then the best 2 of each combined, 64 set-ups per timeframe): Stoch K/D 2/3/5 · RSI/stochastic length 7/9/14/21 · blue level 30/50/70 · MACD 12/26/9, 8/21/5, 5/35/5, 19/39/9, 8/17/9, 24/52/18 · EMA 20/50/100/150/200 · ROC length 20/50/100/200 × level 0/1/2/3/5. Honesty check: settings were picked on 2023–24 (train) and then tested on 2025–26 (test), which they never saw. (15/30-min: train Dec 2025 – May 2026, test Jun – Oct 2026.)

3. What the sweep found

  • 15-min, 30-min and 1-hour lose with almost every setting (buy at close: 1 of 162 settings positive). The trades are too short to pay the charges.
  • Buying during the candle only looks good under the favourable assumption. Under the cautious one, all 270 settings lose. The truth is in between, so it isn't reliable.
  • Settings chosen on 2023–24 failed on 2025–26 almost every time. Buy at close, the best combined set-ups made 4-hour +₹3.01L (train) → −₹2.19L (test); daily +₹4.07L → −₹82k. 0 of 64 4-hour and 0 of 64 daily combined set-ups were positive in the test years. Picking the best settings from the past doesn't carry into the future here.
  • What helped a little, consistently: slower Stoch lines (K/D 5/5), blue below 30 instead of 50, and slower MACD (24/52/18). They cut losing trades on every timeframe but didn't make the fast timeframes profitable.
  • Positive in both periods: daily, buy at close, ROC 20 > 2 / 3 / 5 (other settings yours): +₹1.07L / +₹1.23L / +₹1.51L (ROC 20 > 5: train +₹1.18L, test +₹34k), plus 4-hour ROC 20 > 5 (+₹11k). All four use ROC 20. The follow-up sweep strategy5_roc_ema_sweep.md tests ROC length × level × EMA in detail.

4. Lesson

(Numbers updated 30 Oct 2026 after fixing a floating-point edge case where blue exactly equal to orange wasn't counted as a touch; 0.6% of trades changed.)

Changing indicator lengths doesn't fix this strategy: the same pattern as all earlier tests appears (works in the 2023–24 rally, fails in 2025–26, and short timeframes lose to charges). The exit (sell at the first blue/orange touch) keeps trades too short. Next things worth testing: a slower exit, and the daily ROC 20 > 5 version on Nifty 200.
